system.description:
Growing Unique (long bow +1).

Dormant (when found, save DC 13): arrows from it deal +1d6 of its dragon type.

Awakened (bearer 9th level, save DC 15): the bow is +2, and its long range doubles.

Exalted (bearer 17th level, save DC 17): the bow is +3; a struck dragon makes a Will save or is grounded until the end of its next turn.

Monsters & Treasure, Growing Uniques. Each state adds to the one before. It falls back to Dormant with a new bearer. Its bonus is +1 Dormant, +2 Awakened and +3 Exalted: raise it on the item when it wakes.
